state.intent: Add an original SEC institutional holdings view to the visual morning dashboard, using verified Berkshire Hathaway and Bridgewater quarterly filings.
state.existing: Next16 React19, MorningBoard dark/light design tokens --panel --text --text-muted --accent --border. 390px phone. Existing two-column cards, horizontal bars, section eyebrows, source-drawer buttons, and six instrument/daily-weekly-monthly selectors.
state.data: Two named managers. Each has original SEC current and prior-quarter reporting periods, filing date, report-value total, non-option share value, five largest disclosed share positions by reported value, remaining positions, excluded options/principal values and source provenance. June30 holdings filed August14 are delayed facts, not daily flows. No directional vote or inference about current intent.
catalog: two manager cards with horizontal allocation bars
manager tabs with one allocation view
compact comparison table with expandable largest positions
constraints: Use only verified numeric data; no provider logo or screenshot
Keep report date and filing date visible together; label shares of reported non-option positions, not total AUM
No green/red buy/sell signals or quarter-value change framed as performance
Show broad equity context on MARKET/SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA; hide for TLT rather than imply its holdings
Place immediately after CFTC positioning and before capital panels; no changes to first-screen consensus
Top five share allocations, remainder and direct SEC links; source evidence expands through existing drawer
Phone stack, 44px keyboard targets, reduced-motion compatibility, source-age state

holdings_layout.instructions: Choose the best scan-friendly presentation of these two delayed filing samples without implying a complete institutional market feed.

criteria.paired_allocation_cards: Two equal manager cards with dated reported-value total and five compact horizontal percentage bars plus remainder; stack on mobile.
criteria.single_manager_tabs: One larger panel with manager buttons, the same source dates and bars; only one manager visible at a time.
criteria.comparison_table: Manager/date/value comparison table with disclosure for each portfolio, prioritizing summary numbers over always-visible holdings.
